title: reconstructOriginalSchema never reads its flattenedSchema parameter
rationale: The method does not reference its argument anywhere in its body. It looks up the root record definition captured during flatten and replays stored schema text. It is a memoised copy of the input presented as an inverse operation - the repo signature pathology stated in one line of code.
catchesBugClass: Inverse operations that do not consult the forward operation output - reconstruction-by-memoisation. Any existing test that calls reconstructOriginalSchema and asserts equality with the source is a test that asserts a field was copied.
cannotCatch: It cannot show what a correct inverse would produce, because no code path in the repo derives structure from the flattened schema. It also cannot catch the silent drop inside reconstructRecord for a field whose naive lookup misses.

predicted.detail: Handed an unrelated, field-less record as the flattened schema, the method still returns the original schema. The argument is inert.

configDescription: assert SCHEMA_ARG_IGNORED - feeds an unrelated schema and shows the original comes back anyway
